responsibility: Implements the main declaration-processing machinery for the C++ front end. It creates and validates variables, functions, parameters, types, predefined identifiers, and namespace-scope objects; manages global C++ trees and declaration state such as static aggregates and dynamic initializers; performs initializer checking and cleanup construction; handles auto return-type bookkeeping, COMDAT grouping, and declaration completeness/use rules; and serves as the core builder for front-end DECL and type objects during parsing.
same_name_distinction: Provides the full declaration-processing implementation, including constructing and validating DECLs/types, maintaining declaration-related global state, and helper routines such as COMDAT grouping and auto-deduction checks. Unlike decl.h, which is a small shared interface centered on decl_context and a few declarations, this file contains the substantive machinery.
